question: For how many years does the President of India hold office?
solution:
The correct answer is __**5 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **President of India** holds office for a term of **5 years** from the date he/she assumes office as per **Article 56(1)** of the **Indian Constitution**.
 
• However, the President is eligible for **re-election** after the completion of the 5-year term.
 
• The **term length** does not prohibit the President from resigning before the completion of the term or being removed through the process of **impeachment** as per **Article 61**.
 
• The President continues to hold office **until a successor assumes office**, ensuring no vacancy in the highest constitutional post. This is specified under **Article 56(1)(c)**.
 
• The office term ensures **stability** in governance and provides sufficient time for the President to carry out constitutional duties effectively.
